digest.component_or_area: test harness — nested pytest subprocess isolation
propositions: Nested pytest child invoked without --basetemp joins user-global numbered temp root and triggers costly recursive cleanup of stale entries at session finish, causing timeout after test reports 100%
Shared numbered temp root cleanup cost scales with retained entries; controlled A/B with 400k stale entries showed 10.8s shared-root cleanup versus 0.88s with private basetemp
Nested pytest child must use caller-owned tmp_path/nested-pytest via --basetemp argument to isolate cleanup without altering test selection, environment, timeout, or ambient store assertions
Private basetemp repair prevents nested pytest from deleting unrelated runs' sentinel files and ensures cleanup remains local to current invocation
